non_negotiable_rules: Unknown, absent, malformed, stale, contradictory, unsigned, unlinked, or unverifiable mandatory evidence is BLOCKING.
A documentation claim, source file, configuration, historical test result, ledger entry, or validator structure check is not runtime PASS evidence by itself.

Every mandatory PASS must reference the exact release candidate identity and include execution result, audit evidence, side-effect result, regression result, timestamp, and authorized reviewer where required.

Any post-freeze change to source, lockfile, Dockerfile, deployment definition, runtime configuration, distribution archive, or image digest invalidates affected release evidence and requires a new release candidate.
A human decision cannot override FAIL, BLOCKED, UNPROVEN, integrity mismatch, missing signature, missing reviewer, or an open mandatory P0/P1 control gap.
UNPROVEN is never treated as PASS.
A self-generated signature is not authorized production provenance unless the signing authority is explicitly authorized for the release.
The exact artifact digest must be bound to the evidence package by a detached manifest; a self-referential archive hash is prohibited.
Final production authorization requires all mandatory gates to be PASS and all required authority/review gates to be complete.
